_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 61: 16-21 April 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says that was way before anyone thought about all this, that it was 2023 and they work out it was November of 2023, that it was a long time ago, that he wondered how it would ever come about, and that he saw the crew on the boat.
mentions.quote: I thought, how is this ever going to come about?
mentions.falsify_match: A vessel-borne attack, with the November 2023 telling in this corpus to check against.
mentions.falsify_miss: None in two and a half years.

mentions.claim_text: He says they continued to pray because this is what the Lord showed them ahead of time before the news got it, that they are the news and others come and get news from them because Jesus wants to help them, and gives all the glory to him.
mentions.quote: we are the news. They come and get news from us
mentions.falsify_match: Outlets citing him as a source, which would be visible.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such citations. The claim to precede the news is the one this database exists to test.

mentions.claim_text: He says it looks like they are trying to help them make missiles, that he finds it interesting, and speaks of what the Lord has given and been telling them and how they have been praying for America and for their protection.
mentions.quote: looks like they're trying to help them make missiles
mentions.falsify_match: A missile technology transfer becoming public.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Who is helping whom is not named in the passage.

mentions.claim_text: He refers to the presidential immunity case in 2024 and a memo detailing how the chief was going to handle the decision, notes it was from the New York Times, and says it does not matter because he showed them.
mentions.quote: a memo that detailed how the chief was going to handle the decision
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a news report read out about a past decision.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he was once lost but now is found, that many of them cannot say that tonight because they have never asked Jesus Christ to be their Lord and personal saviour, and that he was blind but now sees.
mentions.quote: I was once lost, but now I'm found
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says Kentucky and that is all the Lord said, asks which one, and says it is a heart of deep state and a heart of the far left, a stench and a hatred, and names Agenda 2030, then says at this place they are not looking at that but want a revival.
mentions.quote: Kentucky. It's a heart of deep state. It's a heart of the far left
mentions.falsify_match: Something in Kentucky matching the description.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named state with a characterisation and no event attached.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for the righteous and for the right ones the Lord instructs them to invest in if he does anything at all, says he may not and he does not know, and prays for certain investments and for certain things to mature and grow.
mentions.quote: the ones that the Lord instructs you to invest in if he does anything
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and the hedging is heavier here than usual: he may not instruct anything, and he does not know.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says this is the foundation the way electricity was, that they should watch what happens with this, and that the beast system comes out of all this, and says he was in awe of something else he was shown.
mentions.quote: This is the foundation, like electricity was. the beast system comes out of all this
mentions.falsify_match: A general purpose technology becoming the basis of a control system.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The same event is the answered prayer elsewhere and the beast system here, which is now a settled pattern.

mentions.claim_text: He says that was on May the 21st almost a year ago and here it is in the news being talked about, calls it weird stuff, and notes people often say he is on some kind of wacky tobacco.
mentions.quote: that was on May the 21st almost a year ago
mentions.falsify_match: The 21 May 2025 telling is in this corpus and can be read against the news item.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not say what he says it says.

mentions.claim_text: He describes underground houses and underground places built to live in because they knew how bad things were about to get, that they were preparing, and that some of these places were called the ark.
mentions.quote: these underground places to go to to live. they called it the ark
mentions.falsify_match: Private underground shelters built by the wealthy, which is already documented.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: this describes something that already exists rather than something coming.

mentions.claim_text: He points to things being brought up in the news in China about trying to create these organs, says it is just like he was telling them he saw in July of last year and it is only now starting to come, and notes Japan has banned it.
mentions.quote: just like I was telling you I saw July of last year
mentions.falsify_match: Lab-grown organ research in China, with the July 2025 telling in this corpus to check against.
mentions.falsify_miss: The earlier telling does not describe it.

mentions.claim_text: He says May 2026, next month, that it is a girl, asks whether they hear it, says he is praying over a girl covered in the blood, and that the child will be a blessing.
mentions.quote: May 2026. It's a girl. I'm praying over a girl
mentions.falsify_match: A girl born to a listener in May 2026, and the sex is a fifty fifty call that can be checked.
mentions.falsify_miss: A boy, or no birth. Only the family can report it.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are in an election year with midterms and people starting to campaign so a lot of things will not get done, that a lot of members of Congress are not going to be voting on things, and that they have until the end of a period.
mentions.quote: a lot of Congress people are not going to be voting on things
mentions.falsify_match: Legislative output falling ahead of the midterms, which is the ordinary pattern.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: political commentary rather than a sighting.

mentions.claim_text: He calls it the coolest thing and says this is signs in the heavens, that as of April 1st the Lord said great signs in the heavens and an acceleration of things, and that somebody sent it to Braden who found it.
mentions.quote: As of April 1st, the Lord said, Great signs in the heavens
mentions.falsify_match: Notable celestial events after 1 April.
mentions.falsify_miss: None beyond the ordinary. The confirming item was sent in by a viewer and found afterwards.

mentions.claim_text: They confirm it was all in the same timeframe and that he found it so it need not be played, note that it is all corn, date it to April 12th, and he says the Lord is talking to them about the corn.
mentions.quote: April 12th. The Lord's talking to us about the corn
mentions.falsify_match: A corn crop failure or price event, with the 12 April telling in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. What about the corn is not stated in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He takes authority over the principalities and powers and demonic spirits trying to hold this back and commands them to bow the knee, calls the wealth of the sinner laid up for the righteous, and calls this bill to pass.
mentions.quote: We call the wealth of the sinner laid up for the righteous
mentions.falsify_match: The bill passing.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not, which the prayer framing absorbs as insufficient prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God for the flow and says the river is flowing and they call it done, calls clarity to come now twice, says even before June and that he sees it then, and says he sees the ribs.
mentions.quote: Clarity come now in Jesus' name. Even before June. I see it then
mentions.falsify_match: The clarity legislation passing before June 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. A real deadline on a real bill, which makes this one of the cleaner tests in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Macron and the man over England and the royals and the lady, that they want to bring forth this new world order and names January 2030, and that they want war over their area.
mentions.quote: they want to bring forth this new world order. This 2030
mentions.falsify_match: A European push toward supranational governance by 2030.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Named living people are cast as authors of it, with nothing they could do or fail to do specified.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls driving down the road in Tulsa and seeing it out of the corner of his eye when the Lord said CarMax is in trouble, that he thought that was interesting, and that he just hears these things when he is driving.
mentions.quote: the Lord said, CarMax is in trouble
mentions.falsify_match: Financial trouble at the named company, which is publicly traded and reports quarterly.
mentions.falsify_miss: It performs well. A named company is unusually specific and fully checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says isn't Jesus wonderful and not Brandon, that he just tells them what he says as he is driving down the road, but that it could be flesh, then turns to the asteroid and to the mayor saying he will tax the rich.
mentions.quote: I just tell you what he says as I'm driving
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, but the hedge is real and rare: he allows that what he hears while driving could be his own flesh.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He reads that an asteroid named for the god of chaos will pass close to Earth in 2029, says he does not think it is going to pass, and that he thinks it is probably the one the Lord has been warning them about and that it is actually going to hit.
mentions.quote: I don't think it's going to pass. it's actually going to hit
mentions.falsify_match: An impact on 13 April 2029.
mentions.falsify_miss: It passes, as every published trajectory says it will. This is the hardest, most checkable claim in the entire corpus: a named object, a fixed date, and a flat contradiction of the observed orbit.

mentions.claim_text: He says he thought his job is over and that he told them he had a help wanted, that he was one of the signs looking for a job in May, and repeats that he thought his time is over.
mentions.quote: he had a help wanted. one of the signs looking for a job in May
mentions.falsify_match: A named figure leaving a post in May.
mentions.falsify_miss: They stay. Who is meant is not stated in the passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says next year he is doing his best, that he told them to pray for that man's safety, repeats it, that he has seen it more than once now with him being taken out by some deranged person on the side of trying to hurt this kid, and that the Lord said to pray.
mentions.quote: I've seen it more than once now him being taken out
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt on the named man's life.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is not named in speech here, and seen more than once is offered as the weight.

mentions.claim_text: He says that regardless of what Paula White or anyone else says, the man may have gone through a hard time but did not go through anything like Jesus Christ did, and that the Lord allowed him to see the crucifixion and what he saw.
mentions.quote: The Lord allowed me to see his crucifixion
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a private vision of a historical event.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a
